paragraphs.text: Honey is one of the few foods that can last almost indefinitely if it is stored correctly. Its high sugar content and low moisture make it difficult for bacteria to survive, and bees add an enzyme that produces small amounts of hydrogen peroxide, which also acts as a preservative. Archaeologists have found pots of honey in ancient Egyptian tombs that were still in good condition. However, honey can absorb water from the air if the container is left open, and once its moisture rises above about 20%, it may begin to ferment.

groups.tip: Metindeki ifade ile sorudaki ifade arasındaki küçük farka dikkat: "good condition" ile "safe to eat" aynı şey değildir.

questions.prompt: Bacteria find it hard to live in honey.
questions.quote: make it difficult for bacteria to survive
questions.explain: "find it hard to live" = **difficult to survive**.

questions.prompt: Bees remove hydrogen peroxide from honey.
questions.quote: bees add an enzyme that produces small amounts of hydrogen peroxide
questions.explain: Arılar onu **üreten** bir enzim ekliyor; kaldırmıyor.

questions.prompt: The honey found in Egyptian tombs was safe to eat.
questions.explain: "good condition" ≠ "safe to eat". Yenip yenmediği söylenmiyor — klasik NG tuzağı.

questions.prompt: Honey stored in an open container may spoil.
questions.quote: honey can absorb water from the air if the container is left open
